hard_rules.message: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
PMEGP is for setting up a new enterprise.
The project must include capital expenditure.
The unit must not already have received government subsidy.

requirements.message: Manufacturing projects above ₹10 lakh require at least Class 8 education.
Business/service projects above ₹5 lakh require at least Class 8 education.

soft_rules.message: Project sector is within the initial PMEGP matching scope.

required_documents.label: Aadhaar or government photo ID
required_documents.description: Primary KYC identity proof.

required_documents.label: PAN card
required_documents.description: Tax identity requested by the lender.

required_documents.label: Business plan
required_documents.description: Explains the activity, expected income and use of funds.

required_documents.label: Recent bank statement
required_documents.description: Supports lender appraisal and account verification.

required_documents.label: Equipment or purchase quotation
required_documents.description: Relevant when financing equipment, inventory or a vehicle.

hard_rules.message: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Applicant must not be in default with a bank or financial institution.
This first version covers loan requests up to ₹10 lakh.
The proposed activity must be an eligible micro-enterprise or income-generating activity.

requirements.message: Transport-vehicle finance must be for commercial use.

soft_rules.message: A business plan can strengthen a lender application.

required_documents.label: Aadhaar
required_documents.description: Used for authentication during portal or CSC registration.

required_documents.label: Bank account details
required_documents.description: Passbook or cancelled cheque for benefit and loan processing.

required_documents.label: Traditional trade evidence
required_documents.description: Any available proof or local verification supporting the notified trade.

hard_rules.message: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Applicant must be at least 18 years old.
Applicant must work as an artisan or craftsperson.
The applicant's trade must be one of the notified PM Vishwakarma trades.
Only one member of a family may be registered under PM Vishwakarma.
Government employees and their family members are not eligible.

soft_rules.message: The work is a traditional craft, so a notified trade should be checked carefully.
The applicant is self-employed in the proposed craft activity.

schemes.name: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation

required_documents.label: Aadhaar or government photo ID
required_documents.description: Identity proof for the applicant.

required_documents.label: Scheduled Caste certificate
required_documents.description: Evidence of the scheme's core category requirement.

required_documents.label: Current family income certificate
required_documents.description: Evidence for the annual family-income ceiling.

required_documents.label: Project report
required_documents.description: Business activity, cost and repayment plan.

required_documents.label: Bank account details
required_documents.description: Passbook or cancelled cheque for application processing.

schemes.purpose: Concessional credit support for eligible Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs.
schemes.manual_verification_message: Your profile meets the core category and income checks. Confirm the applicable NSFDC loan product and State Channelising Agency before applying.

hard_rules.message: NSFDC credit support is for applicants from the Scheduled Caste category.
NSFDC loan support requires annual family income of ₹5 lakh or less.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.purpose: Historical composite-loan scheme for greenfield enterprises promoted by SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
schemes.manual_verification_message: The official source states that Stand-Up India operated only until 31 March 2025. It is retained for historical comparison and is not a current recommendation.

hard_rules.message: The historical Stand-Up India scheme required an adult applicant.
Stand-Up India supported greenfield enterprises only.
The borrower could not be in default with a bank or financial institution.

soft_rules.message: SC/ST entrepreneurs were a priority group under the historical scheme.

schemes.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises

required_documents.label: Aadhaar or government photo ID
required_documents.description: Identity proof for the applicant or authorised representative.

required_documents.label: PAN card
required_documents.description: Tax identity for applicant and enterprise checks.

required_documents.label: Detailed project report / DPR
required_documents.description: Product, cost, contribution, bank finance and viability details.

required_documents.label: Recent bank statement
required_documents.description: Supports bank-finance and contribution assessment.

required_documents.label: Food-business registration or licence
required_documents.description: FSSAI or other applicable food-processing registration.

schemes.purpose: Credit-linked support, training and formalisation assistance for eligible micro food-processing enterprises and groups.
schemes.manual_verification_message: Your activity is within the modelled food-processing scope. Confirm the applicable PMFME component, ODOP priority, beneficiary contribution, DPR and bank-finance requirements.

hard_rules.message: PMFME support is for eligible micro food-processing activities.

soft_rules.message: Existing micro food-processing units are a core PMFME support group.
A business plan can support the required viability and DPR assessment.

schemes.name: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme

required_documents.label: SC/ST certificate
required_documents.description: Evidence supporting the enterprise ownership requirement.

required_documents.label: Udyam registration
required_documents.description: MSE registration used for scheme and lender processing.

required_documents.label: Project or expansion report
required_documents.description: Business activity, equipment and finance requirements.

required_documents.label: New equipment quotations
required_documents.description: Quotations for eligible plant, machinery or equipment.

required_documents.label: Institutional term-loan document
required_documents.description: Loan application or sanction from an eligible lending institution.

schemes.purpose: Capital subsidy and enterprise support for eligible SC/ST-owned manufacturing and service MSEs.
schemes.manual_verification_message: The modelled category, sector and capital-expenditure checks passed. Confirm SC/ST ownership, Udyam registration, new eligible equipment and institutional term-loan requirements.

hard_rules.message: SCLCSS requires an SC/ST-owned micro or small enterprise.
SCLCSS covers eligible manufacturing and service enterprises; trading is excluded.
The project must include eligible new plant, machinery or equipment.

soft_rules.message: A business plan can support lender appraisal of the expansion or new enterprise.

schemes.name: DAY-NULM Self Employment Programme

required_documents.label: Aadhaar or government photo ID
required_documents.description: Identity proof for beneficiary verification.

required_documents.label: Urban-poor eligibility proof
required_documents.description: Local beneficiary, residence or livelihood-mission evidence.

required_documents.label: Micro-enterprise project report
required_documents.description: Activity, project cost and viability information.

required_documents.label: Bank account details
required_documents.description: Passbook or cancelled cheque for loan processing.

schemes.purpose: Interest-subsidised finance and enterprise-development support for eligible urban-poor individuals and groups.
schemes.manual_verification_message: Your profile passes the modelled location, stage and individual project-cost checks. Confirm urban-poor eligibility, covered-town status and local ULB implementation requirements.

hard_rules.message: DAY-NULM SEP is implemented in covered urban areas and statutory towns.
This individual SEP model covers a new micro-enterprise.
The modelled DAY-NULM SEP individual project-cost ceiling is ₹2 lakh.

soft_rules.message: A viable plan suited to local skills and opportunities supports SEP appraisal.

schemes.name: DAY-NRLM Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme

required_documents.label: Aadhaar or government photo ID
required_documents.description: Identity proof for the beneficiary.

required_documents.label: SHG or family-membership evidence
required_documents.description: Evidence linking the applicant to the DAY-NRLM SHG ecosystem.

required_documents.label: Business plan
required_documents.description: Enterprise idea, cost, market and viability information.

required_documents.label: Bank account details
required_documents.description: Account information for finance and programme support.

schemes.purpose: Finance, mentoring and enterprise-development support delivered through rural SHG institutions in approved SVEP blocks.
schemes.manual_verification_message: Your profile passes the modelled rural and non-farm activity checks. Confirm SHG or family membership, an approved SVEP block and community viability assessment.

hard_rules.message: SVEP is implemented in rural areas within approved programme blocks.
SVEP supports suitable small non-farm enterprises.

soft_rules.message: A business plan supports the programme's community viability assessment.
The proposed activity is consistent with self-employment support.

schemes.name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries

required_documents.label: Aadhaar or government photo ID
required_documents.description: Identity proof for artisan or worker records.

required_documents.label: Artisan or traditional-trade evidence
required_documents.description: Evidence of work in the relevant traditional industry.

required_documents.label: Cluster, collective or producer-group evidence
required_documents.description: Connection to an eligible cluster and implementing structure.

schemes.purpose: Cluster-based support for traditional-industry artisans through eligible implementing agencies and producer institutions.
schemes.manual_verification_message: Your traditional-craft profile may fit a SFURTI cluster, but individuals do not apply as ordinary loan borrowers. Confirm a local cluster and eligible implementing agency.

hard_rules.message: SFURTI beneficiaries are artisans or workers in traditional-industry clusters.
The activity must form part of a traditional-industry cluster.

soft_rules.message: Self-employed artisans can benefit through an approved cluster structure.

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises

required_documents.label: Promoter KYC identity proof
required_documents.description: Aadhaar or another lender-accepted photo ID.

required_documents.label: PAN card
required_documents.description: Tax identity for promoter or enterprise checks.

required_documents.label: Udyam registration
required_documents.description: Required for new guarantee applications.

required_documents.label: Business or project plan
required_documents.description: Supports appraisal by the member lending institution.

required_documents.label: Recent bank statement
required_documents.description: Financial information used during lender appraisal.

required_documents.label: Lender application or sanction document
required_documents.description: Evidence of the eligible credit facility; the guarantee is filed by the lender.

schemes.purpose: Credit-guarantee cover for eligible MSE loans sanctioned by member lending institutions.
schemes.manual_verification_message: Your activity is within the modelled MSE scope. Confirm MSE and Udyam status, lender membership, credit-facility parameters and current guarantee coverage.

hard_rules.message: The modelled CGTMSE scope covers eligible manufacturing and service MSE activities.

soft_rules.message: A business plan can support appraisal by a member lending institution.
The proposed credit includes productive equipment or assets.
